skill.name: agent-skill-engineer
skill.primary_outcome: Engineer bounded Agent Skill packages whose routing, structure, behavior, and real outcome can be independently verified.
portfolio_owner_for: skill baselines, A/A noise checks, A/B comparisons, and field-proof design

design_invariants: Evidence precedes prose and production-readiness claims.
Every trigger region has one primary owner and named nearest exclusions.
Only always-needed decisions stay in SKILL.md; optional depth is loaded on demand.
Deterministic and fragile work moves into bounded scripts rather than repeated prose.
Every juror receives the same ordered atomic criterion IDs, descriptions, and required flags.
Host code validates jury output and computes aggregate task success.
New skills compare against a no-skill baseline; improvements compare against an immutable old corpus.
Operational skills require controlled direct field proof rather than proxy success.
Recurring failures are encoded into validators, tests, schemas, scripts, or runtime guards at the owning layer.

source_inputs.used_for: skill qualification, package structure, concise authoring, and evaluation workflow
progressive disclosure, scripts/assets/references, and iterative evaluation
alternative-design exploration, proof-before-claim, automation of repeated method, and encoding lessons structurally

source_inputs.source: procesio-cli field observations and failed identical-corpus A/A run
source_inputs.used_for: direct outcome proof, unknown-write handling, fixed jury criteria, and failure-layer attribution

limitations: Deterministic routing is not proof of end-to-end behavioral superiority.
The previous suite-v2 A/A run measured a dynamic-jury contract and cannot validate the suite-v4 fixed-rubric evaluator.
The meta skill has static, routing, and repository-integration evidence, but its own fresh repeated model A/A/A-B evidence is still pending.
Model-based expert lenses are adversarial design prompts, not substitutes for accountable qualified human review in regulated or high-consequence domains.
